title: Assistant
subtitle: Optional AI help with planning and reflection. It only suggests — you decide what to keep.

unavailable.title: AI isn't set up
unavailable.body: AI assistance needs an API key on the server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env). Everything else in Life OS works without it.

disabled.title: AI assistance is off
disabled.body: Turn it on in Settings. You'll choose what data is sent each time, and nothing changes without your confirmation.

aiNote: Suggested by AI — check before you rely on it.

plan.title: Daily plan
plan.help: Time blocks for your tasks, fitted around your calendar.
plan.confirmBody_one: {{count}} block will be added to your calendar. You can move or delete it later.
plan.confirmBody_other: {{count}} blocks will be added to your calendar. You can move or delete them later.

review.title: Weekly review
review.help: A short look back at your week, with ideas for the next one.

settings.title: AI assistance
settings.help: Optional. Uses an external AI provider for daily plans and weekly reviews. Off by default.
settings.enableHelp: Data is sent only when you press a button on the Assistant page, and only the categories you tick.
settings.budgetHelp: Requests stop when this month's usage reaches it. 0 = none.
